posts.title: BeeBuzz is now Generally Available
posts.description: After a period in beta, BeeBuzz is now Generally Available . BeeBuzz is available for free , with all features included. The Free plan is designed to be enough both to try the product and for basic everyday usage. If you need more traffic, or simply want to support the project, you can move to the Hosted plan . posts.title: Lancert V2
posts.description: I built Lancert to solve a small problem: getting a publicly trusted TLS certificate for a service running on a private network, without setting up your own domain or installing a local CA on every device.
